preconditions.description: T is a positive integer representing the number of test cases, bounded by 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(N.is_integer() and N >= 2 and N <= 10**5 for N in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: Each test case has an integer N (2 ≤ N ≤ 10^5) representing the length of the sequence.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == N for N, A in zip([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]]))
preconditions.description: Each test case's second line contains exactly N space-separated integers.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= a <= 10**9 for a in A) for A in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]])
preconditions.description: Each element in the sequence A is a positive integer between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == [' '.join(map(str, [min_insertions_for_K(A, K) for K in range(2, N+1)])) for A, N in zip([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]], [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])]
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line contains N-1 integers, where the i-th integer (0-based) is the smallest number of insertions needed to ensure no subsequence B(p, q) of length ≥ K=i+2 has any two consecutive elements with GCD 1.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == N-1 for output_line in stdout.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly N-1 space-separated integers.
